lines.text:
If you ever need anything while you're at Snowfield,
give me a ring anytime.

I dressed in what I felt would be appropriate for the owner of a hot spring.
What do you think? Does it suit me?
Have a nice time in the hot spring.

If you're not busy,
would you like to take a walk around Snowfield?

Whenever I'm with you,
it feels like time passes so quickly.

You want to go in the hot spring with me?
... I'll think about it.
I should go and see how things are going at Snowfield.

When are you coming to Snowfield?
I'd love to have tea with you and enjoy the scenery.
Snowfield is always open, so you're welcome anytime.

Do you know where I can buy bath salts?
I was thinking of adding some to the hot springs.
Would you like to come to Snowfield with me?

Even with snow all around you, this is a place where you can cozy up and get warm.
Welcome to Snowfield Hot Spring.
I think I can work a bit harder.
I'm always filled with a sense of gratitude.
You always know when I need a pick-me-up.
You got this for me?
I can show this off at Snowfield.

I should be the one giving you gifts, and yet here I am receiving them from you. 
Thanks.
Don't forget that I'm always thinking of you.
Wherever you are, I will always find you.
... I haven't felt this in a long time.
I've already prepared.

As long as I'm here,
you don't have to worry about getting lost.
I'll show you the way.
I'll take the lead.
Follow me.
Don't get yourself injured, Servant.
Let's hurry and get this done and head back to Snowfield.
Just a moment.
Reloading.
Don't rush me.
Hehe, should we start?
When you're lost, look to this lantern.
I will light up the way.
Why don't we display this at Snowfield?
This is nothing.
Easy pickings.
Ow!
Urgh...
That hurts.
I don't think I'll be able to make it to the hot spring today.
Let's head to the hot spring and take a load off.
